response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_status_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT s.CENTROMEA, s.avg_hgb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_ratio / o.mean_status_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_status_ratio IS NOT NULL
